rows: w_abandon

to leave someone or something behind without intending to return 及物動詞，直接接受詞；abandon a person 指棄人不顧，abandon a vehicle 指棄置車輛。 abandon ship 棄船逃生 放棄計畫、活動或信念 to stop pursuing a plan, activity, or belief 常接 plan、attempt 或 hope；也可用 abandon doing something 表示放棄做某事。 abandon a plan 放棄計畫 完全沉浸於某種情緒或活動 to allow an emotion or activity to take complete control of oneself 用 abandon oneself to，to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞；偏文學語氣。 abandon oneself to grief 沉浸於悲痛 無拘無束；忘情 complete freedom from restraint or worry 不可數名詞，通常用 with abandon 或 with reckless abandon，描述毫無顧忌的行為。 with reckless abandon 毫無顧忌地 desert relinquish retain
w_abate
to become less intense or severe, or to make something less intense or severe 常描述風暴、疼痛或怒氣逐漸減弱；可不接受詞，也可用於 abate a nuisance 等正式用語。 abate a nuisance 消除滋擾 the storm abates 暴風雨減弱 subside intensify
w_abdicate

to formally give up a throne or a position of power 君主退位可直接用 abdicate，或接 the throne；不宜用來泛指一般員工辭職。 abdicate the throne 退位 放棄履行職責 to fail or refuse to fulfill a responsibility 常用 abdicate responsibility，語氣帶有批評，表示不承擔本應負起的責任。 abdicate responsibility 放棄履行責任 relinquish assume
w_aberration
an occurrence that differs from what is normal or expected 可數名詞；常用 an aberration 或 a statistical aberration，表示異常個案，未必代表長期趨勢。 a statistical aberration 統計上的異常現象 anomaly
w_abet
to help or encourage someone to do something wrong or illegal 帶負面含義，常見於法律片語 aid and abet；不適合用來描述一般正面的協助。 aid and abet 協助及教唆犯罪 aid encourage deter
w_abide

to tolerate someone or something unpleasant 此義通常出現在 cannot abide；後面可接名詞或動名詞，語氣比 dislike 強。 cannot abide 無法忍受 遵守規則、決定或協議 to accept and act according to a rule, decision, or agreement 此義必須用 abide by；by 後接 rules、a decision 或 an agreement，不能省略。 abide by the rules 遵守規則 停留；居住 to remain or live in a place 屬古老或文學用法，日常談居住通常用 live 或 stay；此義不加 by。 abide with someone 與某人同住（文學用語） tolerate dwell
w_abnormal
different from what is usual or expected, especially in a concerning way 常修飾 results、growth 或 behavior；描述檢測數值時指偏離正常範圍，不等於已確診疾病。 abnormal behavior 異常行為 atypical normal
w_aboard

on or onto a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle 作副詞時後面不接受詞，常見 go aboard、climb aboard；有受詞時 aboard 作介系詞。 aboard the plane 在飛機上 在船、飛機或火車上；登上 on or onto a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle 直接接交通工具名稱，例如 aboard the plane，不需要再加 on。 come aboard 上船；登機 加入團隊或組織 as a new member of a team or organization 常用 welcome aboard 歡迎新成員，也用 bring someone aboard 表示延攬某人。 welcome aboard 歡迎加入團隊 on board
w_abolish
to officially end a law, system, or practice 常接 law、slavery、tax 等制度性事物；不用於取消單次會議，後者通常用 cancel。 abolish slavery 廢除奴隸制度 eliminate repeal establish
w_abolition
the official ending of a law, system, or practice 通常不可數，常用 the abolition of；談歷史時，the abolition of slavery 指廢除奴隸制度。 the abolition of the death penalty 廢除死刑 elimination repeal establishment
w_aboriginal

relating to the indigenous peoples of australia 指澳洲原住民族時通常大寫為 aboriginal；應尊重當事人的族名與自我稱呼。 aboriginal culture 澳洲原住民族文化 自最早時期便存在於當地的；原生的 existing in a place from the earliest known times 此義較少見，多用於歷史或學術語境；不應將原住民族概括譯成「原始的」。 aboriginal inhabitants 當地最早的居民 indigenous non-indigenous
w_abrasive

a material used to rub a surface smooth or clean 可數或不可數，常見於清潔及加工語境；sandpaper 是一種 abrasive。 a mild abrasive 溫和的研磨材料 有研磨作用的 able to wear away or clean a surface by rubbing 常修飾 material、pad 或 cleaner，指能藉摩擦磨除表面物質。 abrasive paper 砂紙 態度粗魯刺人的 rude and harsh in a way that irritates other people 形容人或說話方式，常見 abrasive manner 或 abrasive personality；比單純的 direct 更負面。 an abrasive manner 粗魯刺人的態度 grit harsh gentle
w_abrupt

sudden and unexpected 常見 an abrupt change 或 come to an abrupt end，強調轉變缺乏過渡。 an abrupt end 突然的結束 言行簡短而生硬的；唐突的 brief and unfriendly in speech or manner 常用 be abrupt with someone，表示對某人的回應生硬，可能令人覺得無禮。 an abrupt reply 生硬的回答 陡峭的；坡度驟變的 very steep or changing level sharply 常修飾 slope、rise 或 descent；描述地勢時比 steep 更強調突然變陡。 an abrupt descent 陡峭的下坡 sudden curt gradual
w_abscond
to leave secretly to escape capture or avoid a duty, sometimes taking something 不及物動詞；abscond from 指逃離某處，abscond with money 指攜款潛逃。 abscond with the money 捲款潛逃 flee
w_absence

the state or period of being away from a place 常用 absence from work 或 during someone's absence；leave of absence 指准假的離崗期間。 a leave of absence 請假期間 缺乏；不存在 the lack or nonexistence of something 用 the absence of something；in the absence of evidence 表示在缺乏證據的情況下。 in the absence of evidence 在缺乏證據的情況下 失神發作 a brief seizure involving a sudden loss of awareness 醫學上通常用 absence seizure，指短暫失去對周遭的意識；不可與一般的心不在焉混為一談。 an absence seizure 失神發作 nonattendance lack presence
w_absenteeism
the practice of frequently being absent from work or school 不可數名詞，常見 employee absenteeism 或 a high rate of absenteeism；具體原因可能包括健康或工作環境問題。 reduce absenteeism 減少缺勤 nonattendance attendance
w_absolute

complete or total 常修飾 certainty、silence 或 disaster；此義通常不用 very 或比較級。 absolute silence 完全的寂靜 權力不受限制的；專制的 not restricted by laws or other authorities 常見 absolute power 或 absolute monarchy，指權力缺乏法律或其他機構的制衡。 absolute power 不受限制的權力 絕對的；非相對的 measured independently rather than in relation to something else 常與 relative 對比；an absolute increase 指實際增加量，a relative increase 通常指相對比例。 absolute zero 絕對零度 不受條件限制的原則或事物 a principle or thing regarded as independent of conditions or circumstances 可數名詞，常見 moral absolutes；哲學中的 the absolute 則指絕對者或終極實在。 moral absolutes 不受情境影響的道德原則 complete unlimited relative
w_absolve
to declare someone free from guilt, blame, or responsibility 常用 absolve someone of blame 或 absolve someone from responsibility；被動形式也很常見。 absolve someone of blame 免除某人的責任 exonerate blame
w_absorb

to take in liquid, gas, heat, light, or another substance or form of energy 及物動詞，常接 water、heat 或 light；不需加介系詞。 absorb moisture 吸收水分 吸收並理解資訊 to take in and understand information 常接 information、knowledge 或 details，強調理解所接收的內容。 absorb information 吸收資訊 使全神貫注 to hold someone's attention completely 常用 be absorbed in something 表示專注於某事；in 後可接名詞或動名詞。 be absorbed in a book 專心讀一本書 自行承擔費用或損失 to bear a cost or loss without passing it on to others 商務中常用 absorb costs 或 absorb losses，表示由自己消化支出，不轉嫁給他人。 absorb the cost 自行承擔費用 吸納；併入 to incorporate something into a larger group or system 常用 absorb something into something；被動式 be absorbed into 指被納入更大的組織。 absorb a smaller company 併入一家較小的公司 soak up engross incorporate emit
w_absorption

the process of taking in a substance or energy 不可數名詞；常用 the absorption of nutrients 或 light absorption，介系詞 of 引出被吸收的事物。 the absorption of nutrients 營養素的吸收 全神貫注；專心投入 complete attention to an activity or subject 常用 absorption in，後接活動或主題；與物理上的吸收義分開理解。 complete absorption in work 全神貫注於工作 uptake engrossment emission
w_abstain

to choose not to vote for or against a proposal 可單獨使用 abstain，也可用 abstain from voting；棄權不同於投反對票。 abstain from voting 表決時棄權 自願戒除；避免參與 to deliberately avoid consuming something or taking part in an activity 用 abstain from，後接名詞或動名詞，常見 abstain from alcohol；語氣較正式。 abstain from alcohol 戒酒 refrain
w_abstention

the act of choosing not to vote for or against a proposal 計算票數時可數，如 two abstentions；棄權者未對議案投贊成或反對票。 record an abstention 記錄一票棄權 有意的戒除或避免 deliberate avoidance of a substance or activity 較正式，常接 from；談長期戒酒時 abstinence 也很常用。 abstention from alcohol 戒酒 abstinence
w_abstruse
difficult to understand because of complexity or unfamiliar ideas 常修飾 theory、argument 或 text；不同於 abstract「抽象的」，抽象內容不一定難懂。 an abstruse theory 深奧難懂的理論 esoteric obscure accessible
w_absurd

so unreasonable or illogical that it seems ridiculous 常用 it is absurd to do something 或 an absurd claim，表示強烈不認同其合理性。 an absurd suggestion 荒謬的建議 人生看似不合理或無意義的荒誕狀態 the apparent irrationality or meaninglessness of human existence 此義通常用 the absurd，常見於哲學與文學；theatre of the absurd 指荒誕派戲劇。 the theatre of the absurd 荒誕派戲劇 ridiculous reasonable
w_abundance

a very large quantity or plentiful supply 常用 an abundance of 加名詞，或 in abundance 表示數量充足；不要寫成 abundant of。 an abundance of food 大量的食物 元素或同位素的豐度 the proportion of a particular element or isotope in a sample or environment 科學用語，常見 relative abundance；指所占比例，須依情境區分原子數比例或質量比例。 isotopic abundance 同位素豐度 plenty scarcity
w_abundant
present or available in large quantities 可放在名詞前，如 abundant evidence；也可用 be abundant in a region，表示在某地大量存在。 abundant natural resources 豐富的天然資源 plentiful scarce
w_abuse

the improper or harmful use of something 常用 abuse of power 或 substance abuse；此義名詞末尾發 /s/，動詞末尾發 /z/。 an abuse of power 權力濫用 虐待 cruel or violent treatment of a person or animal 常見 child abuse、physical abuse 或 emotional abuse；此義通常不可數。 child abuse 虐待兒童 辱罵；惡言相向 rude or offensive language directed at someone 不可數名詞，常用 verbal abuse 或 a stream of abuse，指攻擊他人的言語。 verbal abuse 言語辱罵 濫用 to use something wrongly or harmfully 及物動詞，常接 power、trust 或 drugs；動詞末尾發 /z/，與名詞的 /s/ 不同。 abuse one's authority 濫用職權 虐待 to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently 直接接受害者作受詞；可用 physically 或 emotionally 說明虐待的形式。 abuse a child 虐待兒童 辱罵 to address someone with insulting or offensive language 常用 verbally abuse someone；此義強調用言語攻擊，不是單純提出批評。 verbally abuse someone 以言語辱罵某人 misuse mistreatment insult
w_academy

a school providing general education or specialized training 可數名詞，常見 military academy 或 police academy；英美教育制度中的 academy 未必相同。 a military academy 軍事學院 促進科學、文學或藝術的學會或學院 an organization that promotes science, literature, or the arts 常出現在正式機構名稱中，如 an academy of sciences；不一定是提供學位的學校。 an academy of sciences 科學院 school learned society
w_accede

to take up a high office or become a ruler 用 accede to the throne 或 accede to office；to 是介系詞。 accede to the throne 登基 同意請求或要求 to agree to a request or demand 正式用法，常見 accede to a request 或 accede to demands；不可直接省略 to。 accede to a request 同意請求 正式加入條約或協定 to formally become a party to a treaty or agreement 法律與外交用語，常用 accede to a treaty；名詞形式是 accession。 accede to a treaty 正式加入條約 consent refuse
w_accelerate

to move faster or cause something to move faster 可及物或不及物；車輛加速可直接用 accelerate，減速則用 decelerate。 accelerate rapidly 迅速加速 加快進程；促使更快發生 to happen more quickly or make a process happen more quickly 常見 accelerate growth、accelerate development，強調進行速度提高。 accelerate economic growth 加速經濟成長 speed up decelerate slow down
w_accentuate

to make a feature more noticeable or prominent 常修飾外觀、差異或問題，與 emphasize 相近，但常強調某項特徵變得更顯著。 accentuate the difference 突顯差異 重讀音節或詞語 to place vocal stress on a syllable or word 語音學用法，比日常的 stress 較少見；不要把「加重音」與「帶口音」混淆。 accentuate the first syllable 重讀第一個音節 highlight stress downplay
w_accessible

possible to reach, enter, or use 常用 accessible to 加使用者，或 accessible by 加交通方式；無障礙語境常見 wheelchair-accessible。 accessible to wheelchair users 輪椅使用者可使用的 容易理解的 easy to understand 常修飾 explanation、writing 或 introduction；accessible to beginners 指初學者也看得懂。 accessible language 容易理解的語言 容易聯繫或親近的 easy to contact or talk to 形容人願意溝通、方便接觸，常用 be accessible to students；與 approachable 相近。 an accessible teacher 容易親近的老師 reachable understandable approachable inaccessible
w_accessory

an item worn or carried to complement clothing 可數名詞，常用複數 accessories；包括皮帶、圍巾、手袋等搭配服裝的物品。 fashion accessories 服飾配件 設備的附加配件 an extra component that adds to the usefulness of a device 常用 accessories for a camera 或 phone accessories；通常指主機以外的附加物。 computer accessories 電腦配件 幫助犯罪或掩飾犯罪的人；從犯 a person who helps someone commit or conceal a crime 法律用語，常用 an accessory to a crime；accessory after the fact 指犯罪後協助逃避追訴的人。 an accessory after the fact 事後協助掩飾犯罪的人 附加的；輔助的 additional or supplementary rather than primary 技術語境常見 accessory equipment 或 accessory muscles，表示補充主要功能。 accessory equipment 輔助設備 add-on accomplice supplementary primary
w_accommodate

to provide enough space or lodging for someone or something 常以建築物作主詞，接人數；也可用 accommodate guests 表示安排住宿。 accommodate guests 提供賓客住宿 配合或滿足需求 to adjust arrangements to meet someone's needs 常用 accommodate someone's needs 或 accommodate a request，指調整安排以提供便利。 accommodate special needs 配合特殊需求 使適應；使相容 to adapt to a situation or make things compatible 正式用法中可用 accommodate oneself to something，to 後接名詞。 accommodate oneself to change 使自己適應變化 house adapt
w_accompany

to go somewhere with someone 直接接受詞，用 accompany someone；不要在此結構中加 with。 accompany someone home 陪某人回家 伴隨發生或出現 to happen or be present together with something 常用 be accompanied by；描述兩件事一起出現，不必然表示因果關係。 be accompanied by fever 伴隨發燒 為歌手或演奏者伴奏 to play music in support of a singer or another musician 用 accompany someone on 加樂器；不是單純同時演奏，而是提供伴奏。 accompany a singer on the piano 用鋼琴為歌手伴奏 escort attend
w_accomplish
to successfully complete a task or achieve a goal 常接 task、goal 或 mission，強調經過努力而完成；不要用 accomplish to do。 accomplish a task 完成任務 achieve complete fail
w_accomplishment

something successfully achieved through effort 此義可數，常見 a major accomplishment；履歷中的 accomplishments 指具體成果。 a major accomplishment 重大成就 任務或目標的完成 the successful completion of a task or goal 此義不可數，常用 the accomplishment of a goal，焦點是完成的過程或事實。 the accomplishment of a goal 目標的達成 achievement completion failure
w_accord

a formal agreement between groups or countries 可數名詞，常用 reach an accord 或 sign a peace accord。 a peace accord 和平協定 意見或行動的一致；協調 agreement or harmony in opinions or actions 通常用 in accord with，表示與某事一致；of one's own accord 是固定片語，意為自願地。 in accord with 與……一致 給予權利、地位或待遇 to give someone a particular right, status, or treatment 正式用法，可用 accord someone something，或 accord something to someone。 accord someone respect 給予某人尊重 與某事一致；相符 to be consistent with something 用 accord with，主詞常是說法、資料或行為；不可省略 with。 accord with the evidence 與證據相符 agreement grant agree discord
w_accountability
the obligation to explain one's decisions and accept responsibility for their results 不可數名詞；accountability to 指須向誰負責，accountability for 指須對何事負責，不譯成「可說明性」。 public accountability 對公眾的問責 answerability
w_accountant

a person whose job is to prepare, examine, or maintain financial records 可數名詞；accountant 不一定具有會計師證照，certified public accountant 才明確表示註冊會計師資格。 a certified public accountant 執業會計師 accounting professional
w_accrue

to increase gradually over time, especially as interest or benefits 可不及物，如 interest accrues；也可及物，如 accrue interest。常描述隨時間產生的增加。 accrue interest 累積利息 利益或權利歸於某人 to become available to someone as a benefit or right 正式用法，常用 benefits accrue to someone，to 引出獲益者。 benefits accrue to investors 利益歸於投資人 accumulate
w_accumulate
to collect or build up gradually over time 可及物或不及物；accumulate experience 指累積經驗，dust accumulates 指灰塵漸漸堆積。 accumulate wealth 累積財富 amass dissipate
w_accumulation

the gradual collection or buildup of something, or the amount collected 過程通常不可數；指一批積聚物時可用 an accumulation of，例如 an accumulation of dust。 an accumulation of dust 灰塵的堆積 將利潤留存以增加公司資本 the retention of profits to increase a company's capital rather than distribute them 財務語境可用 accumulation of profits；一般財報更常見 retained earnings「保留盈餘」。 capital accumulation 資本累積 buildup depletion
w_accuracy

the degree to which information or a measurement agrees with the truth or correct value 不可數名詞，常見 check the accuracy of；測量中 accuracy 指接近真值，precision 則常指重複測量結果的一致程度。 check the accuracy of the data 檢查資料的準確性 數值結果所要求的精確程度 the level of exactness specified for a numerical result 常用 to an accuracy of，後接位數或誤差範圍；四捨五入的位數本身不保證測量接近真值。 to an accuracy of two decimal places 精確到小數點後兩位 correctness exactness inaccuracy
w_accurate
correct and consistent with facts or the true value 常修飾 information、description 或 measurement；副詞為 accurately，名詞為 accuracy。 an accurate description 準確的描述 correct inaccurate
w_accusation
a statement that someone has done something wrong or illegal 可數名詞，常見 make an accusation 或 an accusation of theft；指控不等於已證實有罪。 a false accusation 不實指控 allegation charge
w_accuse
to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal 用 accuse someone of something 或 of doing something；不能寫成 accuse someone for。 accuse someone of theft 指控某人偷竊 charge blame exonerate
w_achievement

something successfully done through effort or skill 此義可數，常用 a remarkable achievement；可指一次成果或長期努力的成就。 academic achievement 學業成就 目標或標準的達成 the successful attainment of a goal or standard 此義不可數，常用 the achievement of a goal；academic achievement 指學業表現或成就。 the achievement of an objective 目標的達成 accomplishment attainment failure
w_acid

a substance that donates protons in a chemical reaction or forms hydrogen ions in water 可數或不可數，常見 citric acid「檸檬酸」；酸的定義依化學理論而異，此處採常見的質子酸概念。 hydrochloric acid 鹽酸 迷幻藥 lsd the hallucinogenic drug lsd 非正式且不可數的名稱；閱讀時依上下文判斷，不可把化學語境的 acid 一律理解成毒品。 an acid trip 服用 lsd 後的迷幻經驗 酸性的；味酸的 having acidic chemical properties or a sour taste 常見 acid soil 或 an acid taste；一般描述酸鹼性時 acidic 也很常用。 acid soil 酸性土壤 語氣尖酸的；刻薄的 sharp, bitter, or hurtful in tone 常修飾 remark、comment 或 tone，表示話語尖刻，不是感官敏銳。 an acid remark 尖酸的評論 lsd acidic caustic base alkaline
w_acknowledge

to admit or accept that something is true, especially something you would rather not admit acknowledge 帶有「雖然不見得樂意，但承認事實如此」的語感，因此在論述中特別好用：先 acknowledge 對方說得對的部分，再提出自己的看法，會顯得客觀而有說服力。它比 admit 中性——admit 常暗示承認過錯，acknowledge 只是確認事實。 acknowledge that + clause acknowledge + noun it is widely acknowledged that + clause widely acknowledged 普遍公認的 acknowledge the risk 承認風險存在 readily acknowledge 坦然承認 確認收到；回應 to tell someone that you have received something, or to show that you have noticed them 這個意思是「讓對方知道訊息已經送達」。商務書信中 acknowledge receipt of your email 是固定客套語；網路通訊協定中的 ack（acknowledgement）也是同一個字，指接收端回傳的確認封包。 acknowledge receipt of 確認收到 an acknowledgement packet 確認封包 admit concede deny refute acknowledgement acknowledged admit
w_acoustic
